No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no order path, no live-VM mutation, no secret, and nothing in LANDING_MACHINERY (constraint-readout.yml is not one of its twelve entries). THE CAUSE WAS REPRODUCED BEFORE IT WAS FIXED, which the row demands in terms: the workflow runs checklist_routing_age.py --write, which mutates a STATEFUL register recording which rows it has already reported, then renders the CLAUDE.md session brief FROM that mutated register -- and the register was not in the paths it commits. So the branch carried a brief derived from state that was thrown away, session-brief-guard re-rendered from the old register and graded introduced_block_edited. Reproduced on BOTH surviving automation branches against their own merge-bases (so the competing 'stale base' hypothesis is refuted, not merely unselected), and restoring the one missing file to the tree flips the guard from exit 1 to exit 0. Pinned by a GENERAL rule rather than a one-off assertion: every scripts/ops/<tool>.py --write a commit-to-main caller runs must have that tool's declared output in the same caller's paths:, and a tool whose output is undeclared FAILS rather than being skipped -- the finder found one such tool immediately and it is now declared. Five plants each land and each fail the suite; ONE ESCAPED THE FIRST DRAFT (deleting the unregistered branch stayed green because nothing in the repo is unregistered today) and the rule was hoisted to a pure function with planted-input controls in both directions rather than patched around. 16 tests pass, ruff clean, guard set 76 pass / 1 fail where the one is this guard pre-arming.
